Luke 19:28: And after saying these things, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
Luke 19:29: And it happened that as He drew near Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called Olivet, He sent two of the disciples,
Luke 19:30: saying, “Go into the village opposite. As you enter it, you will find a colt tied, on which no person has ever sat. Untie it and bring it.
Luke 19:31: And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ you shall say this: ‘The Lord has need of it.’”
Luke 19:32: Those who were sent went away and found it just as He had told them.
Luke 19:33: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
Luke 19:34: And they said, “The Lord has need of it.”
Luke 19:35: They brought it to Jesus, threw their garments on the colt, and set Jesus upon it.
Luke 19:36: As He went, they spread their own garments on the road.
